summary: NetEase, Inc. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report, the US/foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a routine press release furnished on Form 8-K) attaching a Hong Kong Stock Exchange announcement dated November 5, 2026. The notice states the board will meet November 19, 2026 to approve unaudited third-quarter 2026 results, to be published that evening Hong Kong time on HKEXnews, followed by an 8:00 p.m. earnings call. No stakeholder acted on a transaction, no pricing or premium applies, and no advisor is named; it is a scheduling announcement, not a special situation.
